_meta_itemized.page_gates: p2 'Campaign Financial Report 2022 / ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTION REPORT' prints NO section total of its own; the gate is the cover's contribution figure 300 (Current=Cumulative=300), which the single real handwritten row reproduces exactly. p3 'ITEMIZED EXPENSE REPORT' likewise prints no section total; the gate is the cover's expenditure figure 140.40, which the single real row reproduces exactly (the handwritten amount is written as 140 with a superscript 40 - arithmetic closure on the cover figure settles it). Both pages still carry the blank form's PRINTED SPECIMEN row, grey-shaded on this copy ('Jon & Jane Doe' / PO Box 128 Coalville UT / 84017 / $435.00 dated 04/15/20 on p2; 'Name of Business' / 'Campaign signs & flyers' / $512.00 dated 04/15/20 on p3) - dropped, and each cover figure closing ONLY without them is the proof (with them the sides would be 735.00 and 652.40). p4 is a BLANK scan page (no printed content, bands=0) - carries nothing.

geometry.basis: rule-detection row banding (rowbands.py) on the page's own printed grid; box spans the full table width of the row

_meta_itemized.notes: Typed 2022 single_total sheet filled in BY HAND, 4 pages, no usable embedded OCR (draft.py returned no text lines for any page). This filing is NOT county-redacted: the donor's mailing address block is fully legible (contrast the other 2022 filings in this chunk), so donor_city/donor_state are read from the page and are Park City, UT - the street line is discarded at read time per the privacy gate and is nowhere in this record. The whole filing is one self-contribution and one printing expense; Reardon ran only this Primary report (the county listing prints 'n/a n/a' against her Pre-/Post-Election cells - a listing fact about what she filed, not a property of this document). DATES ARE A LOOPED HAND and were escalated to 600-1400 dpi cell crops plus a grayscale re-render: the expense date resolves cleanly to 3/21/22 (a two-bump '3', distinct from this writer's loop-form '2'), the contribution date resolves to 2/22/22 (loop-form month digit matching the '22' year loops). The contribution month digit is the one genuinely doubtful glyph in the filing - cell_confidence date=low and the row note says so; no arithmetic depends on it. Geometry spot-verified end to end: p2 band 2 resolves to pct:8.00,31.81,84.00,4.51@p2 and the crop reproduces 'Coleen Reardon ... 300'; p3 band 2 crop reproduces 'PC Printing / Flyers / 140 40'.
